official_definition: (When Attacks) Light-Dark Soul Drive If you banish your 20px from the game, or send your 20px to any "Contractor Ometeotl" Grandwalker Nexus, send two opposing Lives to the Void.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Light-Dark Soul Drive] or [Light-Dark Soul Drive: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Light-Dark Soul Drive]", "give [Light-Dark Soul Drive]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
